name: Green River — Desolation and Gray Canyons
description: The Desolation and Gray Canyon run follows the Green River through approximately 84 miles of roadless high desert in Eastern Utah. The canyon walls reach heights of up to 5,000 feet in places, exposing layers of geological history and supporting a surprisingly diverse range of desert wildlife. The run typically takes four to seven days to complete and ranks among the longer multi-day float trips in the Colorado Plateau region. Its distance from established roads and services makes logistics an important part of trip planning.
hazards: Long shuttle from Sand Wash to Swasey's Beach
points_of_interest: Jack Creek Rapid (II+): first named drop
Three Fords (III): biggest rapid in Desolation
Rock Creek (II+): named rapid above Florence Creek
Joe Hutch Canyon (II+): final big rapid
usgs_site_name: Green River at Green River, Utah (Station 09315000)
